title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 08 JULY 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 07 July 2026 Several spells of showers will occur in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Mainly dry weather will prevail over the other parts of the island. Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the Central hills, Northern, North-central, Central, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Hambantota and Trincomalee districts.
